info.description: Public Application & Client APIs for Layr Platform
info.title: Layr Client API Engine

post.description: Issues an Ed25519 JWT access token and refresh token for an anonymous guest user with null email/phone and is_anonymous set to true.
post.summary: Sign in or initialize an anonymous guest user account

delete.description: Disables TOTP multi-factor authentication, clears the user's encrypted MFA secret, and emits auth.mfa.disabled.
delete.summary: Disable multi-factor authentication on user account

post.description: Generates a cryptographic TOTP secret and QR-code URI for Google Authenticator or 1Password enrollment.
post.summary: Generate TOTP secret and setup URI for authenticator apps

post.description: Verifies the short-lived MFA challenge ticket and TOTP code after password sign-in and issues an authenticated session.
post.summary: Verify MFA challenge ticket with TOTP code

post.description: Verifies the 6-digit TOTP code and marks MFA as enrolled on the user account.
post.summary: Verify 2FA TOTP code and enable MFA on account

post.description: Issues access token, refresh token, and ID token in exchange for an authorization code with PKCE verification.
post.summary: Exchange authorization code or refresh token for OpenID Connect tokens

get.description: Retrieves standard OpenID Connect profile claims (sub, email, email_verified, name) for the authenticated caller.
get.summary: Retrieve OpenID Connect Core 1.0 user claims

post.description: Sends a 6-digit one-time password (OTP) verification code via configured SMS or email provider.
post.summary: Request a 6-digit one-time password code via email or SMS

post.description: Validates the 6-digit OTP code against argon2id hash and issues an authenticated session.
post.summary: Verify 6-digit OTP code and issue authenticated session

post.description: Begins WebAuthn passkey authentication, generating an assertion challenge for the user's registered credential.
post.summary: Begin WebAuthn passkey authentication ceremony

post.description: Verifies WebAuthn assertion signature against stored public key and issues an authenticated session.
post.summary: Verify WebAuthn passkey assertion signature

post.description: Begins the WebAuthn ceremony for registering a hardware or biometric passkey, returning a cryptographic challenge.
post.summary: Begin WebAuthn passkey registration ceremony

post.description: Validates the WebAuthn attestation response and stores the public key credential in auth.identities.
post.summary: Verify WebAuthn passkey registration attestation

post.description: Verifies the password recovery code and updates the user's password using argon2id key derivation.
post.summary: Confirm password reset with verification code and new password

post.description: Initiates password recovery by dispatching a single-use verification code to the registered email or SMS number.
post.summary: Request a password reset verification code via email or SMS

get.description: Lists active devices and sessions for the authenticated user with IP, user-agent, creation timestamp, and current session marker.
get.summary: List active sessions for current user

post.description: Revokes all active sessions for the current user except the currently active device session.
post.summary: Sign out of all other devices

delete.description: Revokes an active session by session ID belonging to the authenticated user.

post.description: Authenticates an application user with email/phone and password, returning an Ed25519 JWT access token, rotated refresh token, and custom claims resolved via public.auth_claims.
post.summary: Authenticate with email/phone and password

post.description: Revokes the active refresh token and invalidates the session record in auth.sessions.
post.summary: Revoke active session and refresh token

post.description: Registers a new application user account with argon2id password hashing, optional auto-sign-in, and welcome email verification.
post.summary: Register a new user with email/phone and password

post.description: Exchanges a valid refresh token for a freshly signed Ed25519 JWT access token with updated claims resolved via public.auth_claims.
post.summary: Exchange refresh token for fresh JWT access token

delete.description: Deletes the user account, cascading active sessions, passkeys, and identities, and revoking authentication cookies.

get.description: Retrieves the authenticated user, verification status, and MFA enrollment status.

patch.description: Asserts email uniqueness, generates a single-use verification code, and dispatches it to the new email address.
patch.summary: Request to update authenticated user email

post.description: Verifies the email code and marks the user's email as verified.
post.summary: Confirm email verification with code

post.description: Dispatches a single-use verification code to the recipient's email address.
post.summary: Request an email verification code

post.description: Exports all personal data, sessions, and identities associated with the authenticated user in compliance with GDPR Article 20.
post.summary: Export comprehensive current user account data graph

get.description: Retrieves all registered WebAuthn passkey credentials belonging to the authenticated user.
get.summary: List registered passkeys for current user

delete.description: Revokes and deletes a registered WebAuthn passkey credential belonging to the authenticated user.

patch.description: Updates the user's password, verifying current password if one is already set. Prohibited on anonymous accounts.
Asserts phone uniqueness, generates a single-use verification code, and dispatches it via SMS to the new phone number.
patch.summary: Request to update authenticated user phone number

post.description: Verifies the phone code and marks the user's phone number as verified.
post.summary: Confirm phone verification with code

post.description: Dispatches a single-use verification code via SMS to the recipient's phone number.
post.summary: Request a phone verification code

patch.description: Merges personal custom properties into the authenticated user.

post.description: Atomically increments or decrements an integer counter in the KV cache with custom step and TTL preservation.
post.summary: Atomically increment or decrement a KV key

post.description: Batch fetches multiple keys from the ephemeral KV cache in a single atomic pipelined round-trip.
post.summary: Multi-get KV entries by list of keys

post.description: Batch stores multiple key-value entries in the ephemeral KV store in a single round-trip.
post.summary: Batch set multiple KV entries

delete.description: Evicts an entry from the ephemeral key-value cache.

get.description: Retrieves an ephemeral key-value entry with session/tenant isolation from the distributed KV store.
get.summary: Get an ephemeral KV entry by key

patch.description: Updates expiration TTL of an existing key without modifying its value.
patch.summary: Refresh TTL of an ephemeral KV entry

post.description: Stores a key-value entry in the ephemeral KV store with { value, ttl } JSON envelope and optional SetNX.
post.summary: Set an ephemeral KV entry with envelope

put.description: Stores raw request body directly in the ephemeral KV store with optional ?ttl= query parameter and SetNX.

get.description: Invokes a PostgreSQL stored procedure or RPC with caller RLS session claims using query parameters.
get.summary: Execute database stored function or procedure (read-only)

post.description: Invokes a PostgreSQL stored procedure or RPC with caller RLS session claims.
post.summary: Execute database stored function or procedure

get.description: Queries PostgreSQL table with dynamic filters, JSON path filtering, pagination, and sorting with RLS enforcement.
get.summary: Query multiple rows with pagination, filtering, and sorting

post.description: Inserts a single row or batch of records into PostgreSQL, automatically applying defaults and returning inserted tuples.
post.summary: Insert single or bulk rows with RETURNING *

delete.description: Deletes a row by primary key from PostgreSQL subject to RLS DELETE policies.
delete.summary: Delete a row by primary key

get.description: Retrieves a single row from PostgreSQL by its UUID or primary key with RLS enforcement.
get.summary: Get a single row by primary key

patch.description: Applies a partial update to a row identified by primary key, validating against RLS UPDATE policies.
patch.summary: Partially update a row by primary key

put.description: Updates a row identified by primary key, validating against RLS UPDATE policies.
put.summary: Update a row by primary key

delete.description: Permanently removes the object from the file storage backend.

get.description: Streams binary object content from the configured file storage backend with byte-range support.

head.description: Returns HTTP headers for the object including Content-Length, Content-Type, and ETag.

post.description: Uploads binary payload into the specified bucket.
post.summary: Upload a file object via POST

put.description: Uploads binary payload into the specified bucket.
put.summary: Upload a file object via PUT

post.description: Generates a cryptographically signed URL allowing temporary read or write access.
post.summary: Mint a presigned capability URL

post.description: Dynamic GraphQL introspection and query engine over PostgreSQL catalog.
post.summary: Execute GraphQL query or mutation

post.description: Extracts dimensions, format, colorspace, EXIF, and structural metadata from an uploaded image payload.
post.summary: Inspect image metadata from binary upload

get.description: Extracts dimensions, format, colorspace, EXIF, and structural metadata from a remote or local image path.
Dynamically fetches, crops, resizes, optimizes, and transforms source images according to imgproxy option specifications.
Returns dynamic cluster manifest, enabled service flags, project metadata, and publishable key for SDK initialization.
get.summary: Get dynamic cluster manifest and enabled services
